text:
sam-partners: heads up - idea for a streamlined co-sell private offer that bundles marketplace commit + appliance install services. aim: reduce procurement friction and give SIs clear incentives. sketch below, pls react.

ivy-sales: sounds good. rough bands? maybe Micro=20k (2%), Mid=120k (9%), Macro=400k (17%). keep discounts simple.

derek-ops: ops note: credits must be metered tokens, not manual adjustments. we'll need a partner_id tag and an offer_code. estimate 2 sprints to add tagging + credit token.

zoe-legal: flag: any "incentive" payments to SIs need clawbacks and proof of deployment. will draft a clause that requires acceptance sign-off + 60d stability window.

raj-si: SI ask: require a 5% implementation bonus for installs completed within 45 days, paid after 90d if usage > baseline. otherwise SIs deprioritize. also want ability to bill PS separately.

sam-partners: agree on PS separate invoicing. proposal: onramp credit = 30% of first-month consumption up to $25k, converts to committed credit at renewal if usage >=80% over first 9 months.

ivy-sales: add a renewal sweetener: if they renew within 30 days of term end, give an extra 4% credit on next term. helps close deals.

zoe-legal: renewal sweetener ok, but cap total discount across terms to avoid revenue recognition issues. will include cap in clause.

derek-ops: implementation checklist: 1) offer_code and partner tag 2) credit_token lifecycle 3) SI payout pipeline 4) pilot dashboard. ETA: 3 sprints if prioritized.

sam-partners: pilot suggestion: single-market run with one APAC SI, 8 customers, 6-week run. collect conversion and SI activity data.

task-bot: Pilot task created: co-sell-bundle-pilot-1766664321. Checkpoints: 2024-06-10, 2024-06-24.

ivy-sales: I'll draft simple quote snippet and share by EOD.

sam-partners: thanks all. pinning this as the pilot thread. post objections now (gov/reg accounts excluded).

raj-si: :thumbsup: onboard for APAC pilot.

zoe-legal: I'll circulate the 1-pg clause tomorrow.

sam-partners: perfect 1 - closing this thread for now, will post quote + pilot brief.
